gloss: memo paper; note paper; scratch paper

definitions.gloss: memo paper; note paper; scratch paper
definitions.explanation: Small sheets of paper used for jotting down notes, reminders, or memos.

examples.japanese: メモ{用紙|ようし}に{電話番号|でんわばんごう}を{書|か}いた。
examples.english: I wrote the phone number on a piece of memo paper.

examples.japanese: メモ{用紙|ようし}が{切|き}れてしまった。
examples.english: I've run out of memo paper.

examples.japanese: {会議|かいぎ}{中|ちゅう}に{気|き}づいたことをメモ{用紙|ようし}に{書|か}き{留|と}めた。
examples.english: I jotted down what I noticed during the meeting on a sheet of memo paper.

notes:
Composed of メモ (memo, from English) + {用紙|ようし} (paper for a specific use).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- メモ{用紙|ようし}に{書|か}く: to write on memo paper
- メモ{用紙|ようし}を{渡|わた}す: to hand over a memo sheet
- {一枚|いちまい}のメモ{用紙|ようし}: a single sheet of memo paper

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {付箋|ふせん}: sticky note — has an adhesive strip, whereas メモ{用紙|ようし} is plain paper.
